Flag = projected rise over 2 points AND at least 60% of pairwise slopes in the last 12 months point up. This is the all-diagnosis queue of the specialty, not lung cancer only.

Flag = projected rise over 2 points AND at least 60% of pairwise slopes in the last 12 months point up. This is the all-diagnosis queue of the specialty, not lung cancer only.
